items.title: Bob Coquille Interview, 1978-11-20
items.q: We only had six men... Oh, Harvey Rubin. Harvey Rubin. Oh, yeah? Yeah, Harvey Rubin was on piano.

ctx.x: Did you say who the clarinet player was? Oh, uh... Start at the top. The high note.

It must have been Harry Shields, I guess. Yeah, Harry Shields on clarinet. The late Harry Shields. And uh, Les Sharky on trumpet. Now let's see who am I leaving out. Joe Rodas trombone. Monk Hazel drums. Piano? We only had six men. I'm trying to think. Oh, Harvey Rubin. Harvey Rubin. Oh, yeah? Yeah, Harvey Rubin was on piano. Because he traveled in his little Volkswagen. He always had a Volkswagen in those days.

items.title: Bob Coquille Interview, 1978-11-15
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, Harvey Rubin may be able to make a, or Laz Muscat may be able to make you a copy, because they've got all the equipment hooked up to copy deals.

ctx.x: I'd like to get another copy of that little, you know, I just cracked my little EP on that Basin Street Six. Oh, really? That Melancholy Rhapsody. I cracked my little 45 on that. And I don't think I'm going to be able to get another one.
Well, Harvey Rubin may be able to make a, or Laz Muscat may be able to make you a copy, because they've got all the equipment hooked up to copy deals.
Well, I have it on, I have it on a cassette. Yeah, that's what I'm talking about. I have it on a cassette. But my little 45 that I made my cassettes from, I cracked my 45.
